The draft neutralizes the effect structurally — 'The candidate binds NOTHING', 'This recording is not a Class B SATISFIED re-record', 'D-056 Class A is not opened' — but nowhere states in terms that DR-104 remains D-056-ineligible after this recording.

The draft's guard is at or above the adopted baseline — D-128, recording against the equally-ineligible DR-105, carried only 'D-056 Class A is not opened', while this draft adds the Class B sentence.
